methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly via WebFetch for all seven vendors on 2026-06-18: getbeamer.com/pricing, announcekit.app/pricing, launchnotes.com/pricing, olvy.co/pricing, noticeable.io/pricing, frill.co/pricing, released.so/pricing. Security/compliance pages were fetched where they exist: getbeamer.com/security (SOC 2 Type II + GDPR confirmed), announcekit.app/security (SOC 2 + GDPR confirmed), launchnotes.com/security (SOC 2 Type II + GDPR confirmed), released.so homepage (SOC 2 Type II confirmed). frill.co/security returns HTTP 404; Frill SOC2 is stated only as an Enterprise-plan feature on frill.co/pricing and Frill GDPR could not be explicitly verified, so Frill GDPR was set to null. Noticeable's pricing page renders prices client-side via JavaScript and returned no numeric data in HTML; the static feature-comparison table confirms tier names and limits and a $0 Free plan plus a 14-day trial, but exact per-tier USD prices could not be independently verified from a live official page and are therefore null (the third-party $19–$399 range was not used to populate any field). All populated prices are taken from the live official pages. accessedAt for every record = 2026-06-18.

Compliance from getbeamer.com/security: SOC 2 Type II and GDPR explicitly stated; HIPAA not mentioned. The '14-day free trial' text on the pricing page refers to a separate Userflow product, not Beamer changelog plans, so freeTrialDays is null.
